label: TheWaypoints
releaseNotes: 0.99 Beta 2: Replace graphical POI tiles with one-cell native distance fields and add an Open POIs controller action. Fields show No GPS, No POIs or Select POI explicitly. Karoo formats distances in the rider’s units. POI/Favorite selection remains available without GPS and clears on confirmed arrival while its native stream is active. Remove/re-add fields if Karoo retains the old graphical layout; bind Open POIs in controller settings. Live Karoo layout and controller dispatch require retesting. Existing Favorites, packs, application identity and signing key are preserved. Based on the original Waypoints idea and codebase by Vadim Sinitskiy.
